bodies.text:
At 8–12, joining a new group can feel like the hardest part. Youth BJJ gives complete beginners a clear way in: meet the coach, learn one movement, practice with a partner, and build from there.

On the first visit, your child can watch or participate while your family sees how the class feels.

Classes meet Tuesday and Thursday, 5:00–5:45 p.m. inside Castle Hill Fitness. Complete the class finder and Joao will personally call to help plan a free visit.

bodies.text: Some adults want a consistent group. Others need focused coaching around a schedule, injury history, or technical goal. Austin offers group classes Tue/Thu from 6:00–7:00 p.m. plus private lessons by appointment. Use the finder to choose a starting point.

titles.text: Group or Private? Find Your Fit.

bodies.text: You do not need to get in shape before starting jiu-jitsu. You need a place where beginner questions are expected and the first step is clear. Adult group classes meet Tue/Thu from 6:00–7:00 p.m. inside Castle Hill Fitness.

One of the first lessons in jiu-jitsu is not how to win. It is how to communicate and respect a boundary. At Joao Crus BJJ, Youth ages 8–12 practice tapping, stopping when a partner taps, resetting, and trying again with a coach. See the Austin class inside Castle Hill Fitness.

Confidence does not have to come before the first class. It can grow when a child gets stuck, listens to coaching, tries again, and sees progress. Austin Youth BJJ is built for ages 8–12, including complete beginners.

Pressure is part of training. Panic does not have to control the response. Adult BJJ gives you a place to practice position, timing, breathing, and technical decisions with coaching. Train Tue/Thu inside Castle Hill Fitness.

Confidence grows through practice: a coached attempt, a clear boundary, responsibility for a partner, then a reset and another try. 

Austin Youth BJJ welcomes ages 8–12, including complete beginners, inside Castle Hill Fitness. 

Classes meet Tuesday and Thursday, 5:00–5:45 p.m. 

Complete the class finder and Joao personally calls to arrange a free visit. 

Your child may watch or participate.
